fusions.name: Tent-Peg Pass
fusions.desc: A thrust at the gallop that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 3% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Trampled Tilth
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground to churned earth, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Steeplechase Stride
fusions.desc: Carries you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.

fusions.name: Sparks off the Flints
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.
